hub.headline: Three practices. One firm.
hub.lead: Business Solutions for a Digital World. B2B partnerships for firms entering the US, AI solutions development, and digital presence.

choose.heading: Choose the practice that fits your problem.
choose.intro: Three practices, each for a different kind of buyer. Start with the one that matches what you need.

fit.heading: Separate practices, one way of working.
paragraphs: Each practice stands on its own. You can start with one and add another later.
They share the same way of working: plain advice and clear steps from the first call to the handover.

Some problems cross the lines. A firm entering the US may also need a website that speaks to American buyers. A team building an application may need clear content to explain it. Tell us about both and we will say how to sequence them.

cta.heading: Not sure which practice fits?
cta.text: Book a consultation and tell us what you are trying to do. We will say, candidly, which practice can help and where to begin.

process.heading: From first call to handover.
process.intro: A clear, sequenced engagement. No theory without traction.

steps.name: Understand
steps.text: We start with your goals, your constraints and what you have already tried.

steps.name: Plan
steps.text: We agree what will be done, in what order, and what a good result looks like.

steps.name: Deliver
steps.text: We do the work and keep you informed as it happens.

steps.name: Hand over
steps.text: We hand over what we built and agree what happens next.

pillars.name: B2B Partnerships
pillars.tagline: Enter new markets through the right partners.
pillars.summary: Market entry research, channel strategy and enablement, partner introductions and regional expansion for international companies entering the United States.
pillars.hub_line: For international firms entering the US. Channel strategy and partner introductions for companies new to the American market.
pillars.lead: We guide international companies into the United States through disciplined channel activity, turning ambition into distribution, partners and revenue.
pillars.do_heading: A focused practice for crossing the border.
pillars.intro: Four disciplines, one objective: a commercial foothold in North America built on real channel relationships.

who.heading: Companies ready to sell in the United States.
who.intro: Our work suits international firms with a product and a decision to make about North America.

items.title: Firms deciding whether to enter
items.text: You want an honest read on whether, where and how to enter before you commit.

items.title: Firms that need a route to market
items.text: You need distributors, resellers or agents, and the terms and training that make them sell.

items.title: Firms ready to grow beyond the US
items.text: Your US engine is running and Canada and Latin America are next.

cta.heading: Not sure where to begin?
cta.text: Most engagements start with a market read. Book a consultation and we will tell you, candidly, where the opening is.

services.name: US Market Entry Research
services.summary: Sizing, segmentation and competitive intelligence that tells you where to play - and where not to - before you spend a dollar on the ground.

detail.text: Before commitment comes clarity. We map the real shape of US demand for your category - where it concentrates, who already owns it, and the regulatory and pricing realities you'll meet on arrival. You get an honest read on whether, where and how to enter.

services.name: Channel Strategy & Enablement
services.summary: Designing the route to market - distributors, resellers, agents - and equipping them with the tools, terms and training to actually sell.

detail.text: The route to market is the strategy. We design the channel architecture suited to your product and margins - distributors, resellers, agents or hybrid - then build the commercial terms, materials and training that turn a partner signature into actual sales.

services.name: B2B Partner Introductions
services.summary: Warm, qualified introductions to the buyers, channel partners and decision-makers who move your category in the United States.

detail.text: Relationships open the US market - and we have them. We make warm, qualified introductions to the buyers, channel partners and decision-makers who actually move your category, then support the first conversations so they convert into agreements.

services.name: Regional Expansion · Canada & LATAM
services.summary: Extending the playbook north and south - adapting channel models for Canada and Latin America once the US engine is running.

detail.text: Once the US engine runs, the continent opens up. We extend your proven playbook into Canada and Latin America - adapting channel models, partner profiles and commercial terms to each market's language, regulation and buying culture.

process.intro: A clear, sequenced engagement. No open-ended retainers, no theory without traction.

final.name: Hand over
final.text: Success is your team running it without us. We transfer what we built and step back.
